runtimes.value: mlx-video (dual-expert pipeline, converted from the original checkpoint; cross-hatch artifact on M5 Max in bf16 and 8-bit, #44 open); ComfyUI native (progressive output corruption on Apple Silicon reported for Wan 2.1/2.2, #15793 open; uni_pc bug #16573); Draw Things (14B series in Official Models since Aug 2025; community configs and Lightning LoRAs); stable-diffusion.cpp (Metal, Comfy-Org or GGUF); diffusers WanPipeline (prompt ignored under transformers 5.0-5.2, HF discussion #11; pin 4.57.1 or use a release with PR #43880); DiffSynth-Studio. Official Wan2.2 code: no MPS
runtimes.note: mlx-video needs the original Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B repo (.pth T5 and VAE), not the Diffusers repo. ComfyUI#15793 was reproduced on TI2V-5B; the 14B is included by title only. kijai's WanVideoWrapper has several open Mac issues (#1856, #1857 float64 on MPS).

fits_128gb.note: the repository (126 GB) holds two experts used one at a time, so the resident build stays below 100 GB; runs on a 48 GB M5 Max in mlx-video

comments.text: **M5 Max (48 GB), T2V in mlx-video**: cross-hatch over the whole frame, in bf16 and 8-bit ([mlx-video#44, 21.07.2026](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-video/issues/44)).
T2V Diffusers ignores the prompt (text-encoder bug) ([HF #11, 30.01.2026](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B-Diffusers/discussions/11)).

Diffusers repositories: the text encoder loads with `embed_tokens MISSING` under transformers 5.x, so the prompt is ignored; workaround `transformers==4.57.1`. ([HF #6, 07–11.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers/discussions/6))
